name: run-organic-social-post-check
description: Checks a draft social post before it goes out: voice match against the account, would a person actually post it, AI-sounding phrases, claims against what the brand has signed off, banned words, disclosure and rights, trend timing, and whether a named person must approve it; rewrites weak drafts. Use alone when you already have the draft, the brand's voice and approved claims; otherwise run run-organic-social.
